selection: Fixed external pathology knowledge; no cohort targets or survival outcomes used to select concepts or prompts.
scope: Morphologic descriptions, not validated annotations. No molecular gene sets. Some invasive structures may be absent from a diagnostic slide.
templates: A histopathology slide of colorectal adenocarcinoma showing CLASSNAME.
An H&E stained colorectal cancer tissue section with CLASSNAME.

concepts.name: infiltrative_invasion
concepts.text: irregular infiltrating malignant glands invading surrounding tissue

concepts.name: lymphatic_invasion
concepts.text: clusters of malignant epithelial cells within thin-walled lymphatic spaces

concepts.name: venous_invasion
concepts.text: malignant epithelial cells invading a vein with a muscular vessel wall

concepts.name: perineural_invasion
concepts.text: malignant glands surrounding and infiltrating peripheral nerves

concepts.name: tumor_budding
concepts.text: single malignant cells and small clusters of tumor cells at the invasive front

concepts.name: poor_differentiation
concepts.text: poorly differentiated carcinoma with little gland formation

concepts.name: well_formed_glands
concepts.text: well differentiated carcinoma with prominent malignant gland formation

concepts.name: cribriform_architecture
concepts.text: confluent cribriform malignant glands with multiple punched-out lumina

concepts.name: solid_growth
concepts.text: solid sheets and nests of malignant epithelial cells

concepts.name: mucinous_morphology
concepts.text: large extracellular mucin pools containing malignant glands and tumor cells

concepts.name: signet_ring_cells
concepts.text: malignant signet ring cells with intracytoplasmic mucin displacing the nucleus

concepts.name: tumor_necrosis
concepts.text: geographic areas of necrotic tumor tissue and cellular debris

concepts.name: dirty_necrosis
concepts.text: dirty necrosis with granular cellular debris within malignant gland lumina

concepts.name: mitotic_activity
concepts.text: numerous mitotic figures in proliferating malignant epithelial cells

concepts.name: nuclear_pleomorphism
concepts.text: markedly pleomorphic hyperchromatic malignant nuclei with prominent nucleoli

concepts.name: desmoplastic_stroma
concepts.text: a dense desmoplastic stromal reaction around invasive malignant glands

concepts.name: fibroblastic_stroma
concepts.text: abundant spindle shaped fibroblasts within the tumor associated stroma

concepts.name: collagen_rich_stroma
concepts.text: abundant collagen rich fibrotic stroma separating malignant glands

concepts.name: tumor_infiltrating_lymphocytes
concepts.text: lymphocytes infiltrating malignant epithelial glands and tumor cell nests

concepts.name: peritumoral_lymphocytes
concepts.text: dense lymphocytic inflammatory infiltrates surrounding the tumor

concepts.name: lymphoid_aggregates
concepts.text: organized lymphoid aggregates at the advancing tumor edge

concepts.name: neutrophilic_inflammation
concepts.text: abundant neutrophils and acute inflammatory exudate in tumor tissue

concepts.name: surface_ulceration
concepts.text: ulcerated mucosal surface with inflammatory exudate overlying carcinoma

concepts.name: muscular_invasion
concepts.text: malignant glands infiltrating thick bundles of intestinal smooth muscle

concepts.name: adipose_invasion
concepts.text: malignant glands infiltrating pericolorectal adipose tissue

concepts.name: serosal_involvement
concepts.text: carcinoma reaching and disrupting the visceral peritoneal serosal surface

concepts.name: micropapillary_pattern
concepts.text: small micropapillary tumor clusters surrounded by clear stromal spaces

concepts.name: tumor_deposits
concepts.text: discontinuous nodules of carcinoma in pericolorectal soft tissue

concepts.name: vascular_proliferation
concepts.text: numerous small blood vessels within the tumor associated stroma

concepts.name: perinecrotic_morphology
concepts.text: viable malignant cells bordering necrotic areas with sparse nearby vasculature

concepts.name: epithelial_differentiation
concepts.text: polarized columnar malignant epithelial cells forming glandular lumina

concepts.name: expansile_tumor_border
concepts.text: a broad pushing expansile tumor border with relatively little infiltrative budding
